Welcome.Title: Edit your career live.
Welcome.Text: Start the game, pick the layout bottom-left and connect. Players, clubs and finances become editable instantly. Open the demo to try it without the game.
Feature.Live.Title: Live editing
Feature.Live.Text: Change values while the game runs; they take effect immediately.
Feature.Undo.Title: Safe undo
Feature.Undo.Text: Every write is recorded. Undo one change or a whole preset run.
Feature.Patch.Title: Patch friendly
Feature.Patch.Text: Offsets live in a layout file, not in code. A game update means updating JSON.
